description: Runs the ledger application's original payment functions against a disposable PostgreSQL database, one process per actor execution, through the CommitRift fault proxy when an operation is to be killed in flight; the confirmation client is a coordinator-hosted test double.

recordPaymentIdempotent.description: UNIQUE(request_id) with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, then confirm.

recordPaymentReconciled.description: Look for the request first, record only when absent.

settleOrder.description: Two autocommit writes: ledger row (idempotent), then the order status.

settleWithAudit.description: Transaction; the audit row is written through the pool.
